text: You read "High structure pausing inside the swing: buying a higher low." That is the trade my method forbids: buying the reaction itself before a new high proves it over (C5). structure 88.4 says the trend may be sound; structure_shift RANGE says the reaction has not ended. Both can be true, and the second decides entry. I would rather pay up on a fresh high than guess the low (C5: never regret the missed lower price). What clears my objection: structure_shift turning BULLISH_BOS on a close above pivot_high. Then I buy it, not before.
